_instructions: PERMANENT release-channel URLs — do NOT change apkUrl / tvApkUrl / desktopUrl / ipaUrl for a routine release. To ship a new build you REPLACE the binary behind each URL and update ONLY the version fields + release notes plus the matching sha256/bytes. Per-platform overrides (tvVersion*, desktopVersion*, iosVersion*) let TV, Windows EXE, and iOS ship on their OWN tracks; when null they fall back to the top-level Android values. ⚠️ Each per-platform versionCode MUST equal the versionCode that platform actually BUILDS with (tvApp/build.gradle.kts for TV, PlatformAppVersion.desktop.kt + composeApp packageVersion for EXE, iosApp/project.yml for iOS) — a mismatch makes that platform show a false 'update available'. AFTER BUILDING, fill in the sha256 + bytes for every platform (empty string / 0 = the app skips integrity verification for that platform until you provide them). Compute with: sha256sum <file>  and  stat --format=%s <file>
